capital_constraint: EUR200 once remains mandatory downstream; this is cheap pre-account screen, no sum claimed as a feasible portfolio return. Shared existing account replay only if separately admitted survivor.
decision: DATA_LIMITED first if censoring exceeds5%; then support, gross, scenario net and all-five-day gates. Any rejection stops this fixed model with no tune or automatic successor. A pass is only DEVELOPMENT_SURVIVOR_UNCONFIRMED, requires separate continuousEUR200/margin/risk and actual-cost admission before confirmation. HARD21 remains unproven.
economics: 1000 GBP base units as a normalization, not observed executable minimum. Long buysASK/sellsBID, short sellsBID/buysASK. Observed spread included. One MODEL reference feeUSD10/100000 base units roundtrip=.10USD and0.1pip slippage per side=.02USD. netUSD=grossUSD-.12USD; signed net converted using exit strictly prior EURASK for gains/EURBID for losses. No additional fee grid. Historic fees, minima, slippage, fills and margin unproven.
entry: First valid GBP quote at or after decision+5000ms, no later than+10000ms. Any invalid GBP route after decision cancels/censors. One pending/active episode only.
exit: First valid GBP quote at/after actual entry+60000ms, no later than+65000ms, absolute decision+80000ms. Invalid route, session escape, timeout or terminal holding is censored, not zero, stop or free exit. Censor locks new episodes through decision+80000ms.
hypothesis: A completed approximately60sec EURUSD common USD shock not yet matched by GBPUSD predicts GBPUSD catch-up over the next60sec. Fixed unit elasticity, no fitted beta, spread-conditioned signal. Distinct from price-level pair OLS reversion and closed single-instrument models. Microstructure efficiency and source-time uncertainty may make it unexploitable.
multiplicity: Dependent exploratory B-E research, one additional mechanism/model and one friction scenario. Preserve every prior exposure/rejection/C033/formalV2 budget; no claim of independent market evidence from Python/CSharp parity.
privacy: Every economic number, decision and episode encrypted to existing custody public key; public only source counts, identity, parity and disposition.
sampling: Exactly first GBP update of each UTC minute; it must be within5000ms after boundary, with valid GBP sides and strictly prior valid EUR sides age<=5000ms. Consecutive minute samples required; compare mid returns at actual sample times. Invalid/late sample breaks history. Source-time proxy, not historical arrival.
session: Monday-Friday06:00 through19:57:59.999UTC; all decisions/entries/exits must satisfy session. No rollover carry modeled; actual financing calendar not certified.
signal: For f=EUR midpoint simple return and g=GBP midpoint simple return between samples, spread=(GBPask-GBPbid)/GBPmid>0. direction=sign(f) if abs(f)>=4*spread and sign(f)*(f-g)>=2*spread; otherwise0. Both signs belong to one model. No fit, grid, symbol selection or parameter retry.
